title: Backlash over the 2021 transients paper co-authored with Jeff Marcy
summary: Beatriz Villarroel tells of Backlash over the 2021 transients paper co-authored with Jeff Marcy, about 2015-2021+ at Astronomy community, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in 2021 uh when we did this discovery of the nine transients uh I published a paper with my colleague Jeff Marcy. So he had been uh cancelled in a uh sexual harassment scandal in 2015.

plain: An astronomer named Beatriz Villarroel, who looks for unexplained objects in the sky, says that in 2021 her team found nine transients, points of light that show up in old sky images and then vanish. She says she published the paper with a colleague, Jeff Marcy, an astronomer who had been pushed out of the field over a sexual harassment scandal in 2015. According to her, working with him brought a backlash in the astronomy world that coloured how people received the discovery.
